passage:
declining — 下降的，减少的
Elena Torres, a marine biologist, claimed that the local seagrass beds were declining rapidly.

seasonal — 季节性的
Samuel Reed, an environmental chemist, argued that the decline was seasonal, not permanent.

conclusive — 结论性的，决定性的
He wrote, "The data are not yet conclusive." His tone was calm, but his message was less urgent.

moderated — 主持（讨论等）
The two scientists then agreed to a public debate, moderated by a science journalist.

acknowledged — 承认
He acknowledged that his winter data might miss summer changes.

cooperation — 合作
The audience was surprised by how quickly the disagreement turned into cooperation.

coverage — 覆盖范围
Water temperature, light levels, and seagrass coverage were measured every month.

effectively — 有效地
How was this disagreement communicated so effectively?
